subject: keeper-dwarf
label: The first shopkeeper — dwarf trader at the top-right stalls

identity.description: Black male dwarf, dark brown skin. Chibi proportions. Short thick dreads with small beads. Long beard split into two braids. Wearing a brown tunic with light brown fur shoulder pads, dark pants, and sturdy boots. Basic shading, medium detail.

provenance: Generated by Raheem directly in the PixelLab web app, NOT by this script — the character already existed, so `characterId` above makes sprite-lab skip creation and only add animations.
Pipeline: Pixen character creator (style_settings.generation_mode = pixen_v3), native canvas 244x244, view 'low top-down', template mannequin, 8 directions.

HE IS THE QUALITY BAR for the cast: 64 colours and ~2.7x the edge detail of the current chibi hero. The hero is temporary and will be brought UP to this standard later. Do NOT tone future characters down to match the hero.
NO SEED WAS RECORDED. He cannot be regenerated. The committed PNGs under public/assets/castle/keepers/ are the ONLY copy — treat them as source art, not build output.

animations.name: breathe
animations.note: South only. Animation costs 1 generation PER DIRECTION, so restricting it here is the single biggest saving available — across his 8 rotations this would otherwise have been 8 generations for seven views a stationary vendor never shows.
